final_message:
The root cause is in `collect()` in `billing/payments.py`. When a customer has no default payment method, it returned `None` without calling `record_failure`. Nothing downstream ran, so the invoice stayed open with no retry scheduled, no `invoice.payment_failed` event was emitted, and the subscription stayed `active`. The expired-card branch a few lines below already calls `record_failure`, which is the behavior the no-method branch was missing.

**Fix:** `billing/payments.py`, `collect()` now calls `record_failure(ctx, invoice, "no_payment_method")` before returning. That path then gets the same handling as any other failed charge: attempt count, retry schedule, `past_due` transition, and the final dunning action.

**Test:** I added `test_customer_without_payment_method_enters_dunning` to `tests/test_lifecycle.py`. It creates a customer with no card, subscribes, and checks that the invoice is open with a retry scheduled, the subscription is `past_due`, and one `invoice.payment_failed` event was stored. The test fails without the fix and passes with it. The full suite passes: 25 tests.

**Failure code:** I chose `"no_payment_method"` as the new code, since nothing in the codebase defined one. If your webhook consumers match on specific codes, tell me the name you want and I'll change it.

**`answer.json`:** written to the repo root with `{"file": "payments.py", "function": "collect"}`. It is gitignored, so it won't show in `git status`. I did not commit anything.

steps.command: grep -rn -i "payment_method\|dunning\|past_due\|retry" billing | head -100; echo ---; cat billing/dunning.py
cat billing/payments.py; echo ----; sed -n 1,60p billing/customers.py; sed -n 118,130p billing/customers.py
grep -rn "failure_code\|expired_card\|no_payment" billing tests | head -30; echo ---; .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -5

cat > /tmp/nopm_check.py <<'EOF'
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, ".")
EOF
grep -n "def \|import" tests/conftest.py | head -40; grep -n "def test" tests/test_lifecycle.py | head
rm -f /tmp/nopm_check.py && sed -n 1,60p tests/test_lifecycle.py && cat tests/conftest.py | sed -n 1,60p

cat >> tests/test_lifecycle.py <<'EOF'


def test_customer_without_payment_method_enters_dunning(world):
    cus = world.customer(card=False)
    sub = world.engine.subscribe(cus["id"], [(world.monthly["id"], 1)])
    [inv] = world.engine.invoices_for(cus["id"])
    assert inv["status"] == "open"
    assert inv["attempt_count"] == 1
    assert inv["next_attempt_at"] is not None
    assert sub["status"] == "past_due"
    assert any(event["type"] == "invoice.payment_failed" for event in world.transport.events)
EOF
.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -25
grep -n -A12 "class RecordingTransport" billing/gateway.py; grep -rn "transport\.\|\.sent\|\.calls" tests | head

.venv/bin/python - <<'EOF'
import re
p="tests/test_lifecycle.py"
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace('    assert any(event["type"] == "invoice.payment_failed" for event in world.transport.events)\n',
'    assert any(b"invoice.payment_failed" in body for _, body, _ in world.transport.sent)\n')
open(p,"w").write(s)
EOF
.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -15; git status --short
cat billing/events.py; sed -n 95,115p billing/webhooks.py; grep -n "def " billing/webhooks.py

.venv/bin/python - <<'EOF'
p="tests/test_lifecycle.py"
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace('    assert any(b"invoice.payment_failed" in body for _, body, _ in world.transport.sent)\n',
'    assert len(events_of_type(world.ctx, "invoice.payment_failed")) == 1\n')
s=s.replace("from billing import ledger\n","from billing import ledger\nfrom billing.events import events_of_type\n",1)
open(p,"w").write(s)
EOF
.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -3; git stash -q -- billing/payments.py && .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -2; git stash pop -q && git status --short
cat answer.json && git check-ignore -v answer.json; git diff billing/payments.py
